channel.description: Corporate Company Earnings, Find Earnings Per Share and Earnings History Online

item.title: We're upgrading our rating on Boeing as CEO Ortberg's turnaround bears fruit
item.description: Boeing's second-quarter results leaped over Wall Street expectations on the financial metric that matters most.

item.title: Ford raises guidance after Q2 earnings beat, says F-Series recovery is on track
item.description: Ford cited operational improvements, resilient vehicle pricing and a high sales mix of profitable products for its performance and the improved guidance.

item.title: Corning tumbles 12% after earnings, leading rout in optical stocks
item.description: Marvell, Lumentum, AXT and Coherent were down double digits following the Corning print.

item.title: Amazon, Meta and Microsoft face skeptical investors this week after Google report sparked sell-off
item.description: Alphabet's free cash flow has turned negative, and the company lifted its capital spending forecast. Slower-growing cloud rivals report this week.

item.title: Boeing posts wider loss than expected as Air Force One costs weigh on results
item.description: Boeing took a $280 million charge on its long-delayed Air Force One program.

item.title: Coca-Cola hikes full-year forecast. CEO tells CNBC the World Cup boosted its brands
item.description: Coca-Cola said demand for its drinks rose in every market in the second quarter, helped in part by the World Cup.

item.title: UPS expects third-quarter domestic revenue to be flat but CEO tells CNBC the company is through its 'bumps'
item.description: UPS beat Wall Street expectations and raised its full-year guidance in its second-quarter earnings report Tuesday.

item.title: Volkswagen CFO addresses plant closures, job losses as profits sink
item.description: German auto giant Volkswagen on Friday reported weaker-than-expected second-quarter profit and revised down its sales forecast for 2026.

item.title: Intel's turnaround under CEO Lip-Bu Tan gains steam with another strong quarter
item.description: It's hard not to be impressed by Tan, who, in a little more than a year, has transformed the company.

item.title: Intel rides AI boom to fastest revenue growth in almost 15 years, but shares sink
item.description: Intel's revenue jumped 25%, the most robust growth for any period since the third quarter of 2011.

item.title: We're raising our Honeywell Technologies price target, reflecting post-spinoff optimism
item.description: Honeywell Technologies bucked a broader market selloff after the industrial automation company delivered a strong quarter and raised guidance.

item.title: We're ready to move on from Dover after the industrial conglomerate's weak quarter
item.description: We're downgrading the stock because our money can be put to better use elsewhere.

item.title: Albertsons stock plunges as it says weaker grocery spending will cut into sales and earnings
item.description: Shares of Albertsons sank Thursday after the grocer reported softness in its core business and lowered its full-year outlook as a result.

item.title: Comcast earnings highlight NBCUniversal strength ahead of planned split
item.description: Comcast said earlier this year it would split the cable businesses from the media business, creating two separate publicly traded companies.

item.title: American Airlines stock tumbles 8% as fuel spike further postpones turnaround
item.description: American Airlines further cut its 2026 earnings outlook, citing higher fuel costs.

item.title: Alphabet and Tesla test Wall Street's patience as AI spending overshadows growth
item.description: Shares of Alphabet and Tesla dipped after the companies reported massive spending increases in their quarterly earnings reports.

item.title: Why we're sticking with Alphabet despite an imperfect quarter and more AI spending
item.description: The market isn't in a forgiving mood, but we're not in a hurry to leave this stock behind.

item.title: Southwest Airlines' third-quarter forecast falls short as fuel bill climbs
item.description: Southwest Airlines reported a more than 9% increase in second-quarter profit as higher fares are increasingly helping the airline cover its fuel tab.

item.title: IBM lowers full-year forecast after earnings warning
item.description: IBM is now looking to improve productivity with artificial intelligence, including with a new coding tool called Bob.

item.title: GE Vernova sellers blinded by an earnings miss should focus on strong demand instead
item.description: Using the EPS miss as a reason to knock the Club stock down more than 7% is short-sighted.

item.title: Tesla misses on earnings, as free cash flow turns negative and margins slide
item.description: Tesla's earnings report lands in the midst of a slide in the company's stock price even as its core auto business is rebounding.

item.title: Capital One earnings were good enough but didn't answer the big question hanging over the stock
item.description: Investors want to know when Capital One will begin to see more tangible benefits from its Discover and Brex deals.

item.title: Super Micro surges 15% on new order and margin disclosure after SpaceX announcement
item.description: Many server makers are seeing faster growth as companies race to deploy artificial intelligence servers.

item.title: GM beats on earnings, raises guidance amid 'resilient' consumer, pricing
item.description: GM raised several key earnings forecasts after beating Wall Street's second-quarter expectations as its North American operations continue to drive results.

item.title: Ryanair says 'no shortage' of travelers despite Iran war denting profit
item.description: Ryanair's first-quarter profit took a 34% hit as consumers delayed bookings due to the Middle East crisis, while struggling airlines face a "difficult winter."

item.title: Netflix stock falls as earnings forecast disappoints, company says it will give fewer engagement updates
item.description: The streaming giant said it would cut back on the frequency of its "What We Watched" reports, which provide a picture of engagement.

item.title: UnitedHealth blows past estimates, hikes earnings outlook as it reins in costs
item.description: The healthcare giant is working to stabilize margins by shrinking membership, exiting unprofitable contracts and pouring $1.5 billion into AI.

item.title: TSMC to invest additional $100 billion in Arizona after second-quarter profit soars 77%
item.description: TSMC announced a second-quarter profit, following its June revenue figures released earlier this week.

item.title: United earnings top estimates but airline expects $6 billion in added fuel costs
item.description: United reported higher revenue for premium, corporate and no-frills basic economy tickets and higher revenue for both domestic and international trips.

item.title: J&J falls despite a beat-and-raise quarter. Why we're raising our price target anyways
item.description: Johnson & Johnson's quarter was imperfect, but enough is going right to validate our ownership of the stock.
